notes: §1985:IV.4.3.2.1 lists three entry types "for which there is no true concept of level", and GR2 is "Entries that specify noncontiguous working storage and linkage data items."; the same clause gives them level-number 77 as items "which are not subdivisions of other items, and are not themselves subdivided". DataBinder.BindEntries (its AttachToHierarchy step) nests a level-77 entry as level 1, so it closes any open record and is always a root, and a 02-49 entry after it finds no open item and is refused (COBOL2771). LevelNumberRules.Classify with LevelNumberPass.VisitLevelNumber admits 77 only in the working-storage, local-storage and linkage arm (COBOL1746 under an FD, SD, CD or RD), CheckEntryFormat with EntryNameObligation requires its data-name (COBOL1747; §1985:VI.5.2.1 lists data-name as required), and at 85 VersionConformancePass.VisitLocalStorageSection refuses the LOCAL-STORAGE SECTION (COBOL0900), which leaves the two sections the 1985 rule names. Probed at --std 85: a 77 between two records has its own storage (MOVE ALL to the record before it leaves it unchanged, and the reverse), cannot be qualified by that record, takes an 88 and a REDEFINES of another 77, and passes as a LINKAGE parameter in both directions (v1.cob, v9.cob); refused: a 05 after a 77, a 77 with no PICTURE, an unnamed or FILLER 77, OCCURS on a 77, a 66 after a 77, a 77 in the FILE, COMMUNICATION and REPORT sections. The witness displays two WORKING-STORAGE 77 items.

next.reason: A case is added to the enumeration. 1985: 'Entries that specify noncontiguous working storage and linkage data items' (§1985:IV.4.3.2.1 GR2). 2023: 'Entries that specify noncontiguous working-storage, local storage, and linkage data items' (§2023:8.5.1.3.2 GR2), and level 77 identifies 'noncontiguous local storage data items' too (§2023:13.18.33.4 GR2). A level-77 entry in the local-storage section, outside the 1985 list, is accepted in 2023: the range of special noncontiguous entries is widened. GR-8.5.1.3.2-3 (the level-number assignment) is the 1985 trailing paragraph, not this item.
